column3: “They have filled you” is rendered “Your messengers,” following a different reading, and joined to v. 3.
“The seed of Shihor” is rendered “the grain of the Nile,” and “traffic” as “market.”
“Its feet carried it” is rendered “Whose feet used to carry her,” and “to sojourn” as “to colonize.”
“Pass over” is rendered “Overflow,” and “the River” as “the Nile.”
“A holy thing” is rendered “set apart,” and “covering” as “choice attire.”
